title: MR elastography (MRE)
description: An MR elastography measures tissue stiffness to detect organ disease like liver fibrosis. This specialized outpatient MRI creates maps showing tissue elasticity, stiffer tissue indicates disease. You lie still in the MRI scanner while vibrations are applied and images captured. The procedure takes 20-30 minutes and is painless. Results help your doctor assess liver damage severity, monitor disease progression, or guide treatment decisions without requiring invasive biopsy. You go home immediately with no recovery needed.
